## Beginning June 1, 2026, at 8:00am, interested organizations will be able to submit an Expression of Interest (EOI) by clicking here:

# Orlando Health Community Grant Program

As part of Orlando Health’s ongoing commitment to engage and support communities throughout Florida, and in alignment with our mission to improve the health and quality of life of the individuals and communities we serve, we are pleased to offer competitive funding through the Orlando Health Community Grant Program. These grants support community-based initiatives that promote health and wellness and address priority needs affecting individuals and families.

Funding will focus on initiatives aligned with the top priorities identified in the most recent Community Health Needs Assessment (CHNA), with a particular emphasis on enhancing access to care. The grant program is one way Orlando Health supports community-driven efforts to strengthen the communities we serve.

Click the link below to view the funding priorities for each county eligible for the 2026 – 2027 grant cycle.

## Process

#### Portal Registration

All individuals interested in applying for an Orlando Health Community Grant must first register in the online grant portal. Registration: [Click Here](https://orlandohealthcrm.my.site.com/GrantPortal).

#### Expression of Interest (EOI)

The grant application window will open on June 1 at 8:00 a.m. All applicants are required to complete an Expression of Interest (EOI), which provides a brief overview of the funding request and the proposed program.

Upon submission, applicants will receive a confirmation email. The deadline to complete the EOI is 11:59pm on Sunday, June 21, 2026.

#### Full Proposal

On Wednesday, July 1, 2026, organizations that submitted an EOI will receive an email notification indicating whether they are invited to submit a full application.

Organizations selected to advance must submit a full application, including all required supporting documents, by 11:59pm on Sunday, July 26, 2026.

*Please note: Team members should refer to SWIFT for more information on the team member grant application process.*

# Financial Assistance Program

## Patient Financial Resources

## Need Help Paying Your Bill?

In an effort to meet the community’s healthcare needs, financial assistance is available to patients/guarantors (person that is financially responsible) who have limited or no resources to pay for emergent or medically necessary services rendered at an Orlando Health facility.

Financial assistance applies to bills from Orlando Health Hospitals and employed physicians. All Orlando Health employed physicians must follow Orlando Health’s Financial Assistance Policy (FAP). Contracted, Community/Private providers are not required to participate in Orlando Health’s financial assistance program.

## How Do I Qualify for Financial Assistance?

Financial assistance is based on information that considers your yearly income and family size. Based on current Federal Poverty Guidelines, you may qualify for assistance with all of your hospital bill through a review of your income, assets, and other resources. Federal Poverty Guidelines can be found at <https://aspe.hhs.gov/poverty-guidelines>

If a validated financial statement application reflects an income at or below 225% of the most current Federal Poverty Level for the stated family size, the account will qualify for financial assistance in its entirety.

## How Can I Apply for Financial Assistance?

**To apply for financial assistance, please review our financial assistance policies, and complete the Guarantor Financial Statement Application (GFSA) below.**

Patients can get help with the financial assistance program application process at Orlando Health business office locations before, during or after the patient's hospital stay. You can apply for help with your bill in person or by mail.

For assistance with the application process, please contact:

Billing Customer Service  
Open Monday – Friday, 8:30 am – 4:30 pm  
Phone [(321) 841-2596](tel:3218412596) or [(877) 793-0145](tel:8777930145)

Or email: [FinancialAssistance@OrlandoHealth.com](mailto:FinancialAssistance@OrlandoHealth.com)

## Paperwork

You are responsible for providing timely information about your health benefits, income, assets, and any other paperwork that will help to see if you qualify. Paperwork might include bank statements, income tax forms, check stubs, or other documents.

## Collection Activities

You are responsible for any bills until your application has been reviewed and approved for financial assistance. Bills that are not paid 240 days after the first billing date may be reported on the patient/guarantor credit history.

Contact us if you have any questions or concerns about billing or the collections process.

## Pricing Estimates

We aim to provide pricing transparency to our patients. You may request a price estimate of services by calling our toll-free number: [(844) 318-4855](tel:8443184855).

## Participating Physicians

All Orlando Health employed physicians must follow Orlando Health’s Financial Assistance Policy (FAP). Contracted, Community/Private providers are not required to participate in Orlando Health’s financial assistance program. For a list of employed and contracted Orlando Health physicians, [click here](https://orlandohealth.getbynder.com/asset/08568a5c-fa43-41d7-8701-fe8fd0d33b7a/202506-OH-501r-Physician-Listing.xlsx).

#### Disability and Life Insurance

Orlando Health provides group term life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability at no cost to our team members. Life insurance options for self, spouse and children are available.

Education Programs

### Education Programs

Finances shouldn’t be a roadblock to your career. We offer a Preferred Education Program that allows you to pursue an associate degree, bachelor’s degree or technical certificate at select institutions with no out-of-pocket costs! Other educational assistance programs include tuition reimbursement (up to $5,000 a year) and student loan repayment ($1,200 per year) for eligible team members and free programs to help you obtain your high school diploma or pursue English as a second language. [...] #### Paid Time Off (PTO)

We know the flexibility to take time off work is important to your well-being. That’s why Orlando Health offers a comprehensive PTO policy that gives you time off for vacation, holidays, personal business or personal and family illness. New, full-time team members can earn nearly five weeks of PTO each year! We also offer a voluntary PTO cash-in option (at 75% value) four times a year.

#### Retirement Savings Plan

No matter how much you love your career, you likely still dream about retirement. Orlando Health cares about your future financial security and offers up to a 5% matching contribution.

#### FSAs and HSAs

Our flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts offer a variety of options to help you save money on healthcare spending. [...] - Four weeks paid parental leave for benefits-eligible team members
- Fertility Benefits, up to $25K lifetime maximum
- Adoption Assistance, up to $15K per child toward eligible expenses
- Back-up Child Care, Elder Care and Pet Care
- Virtual and In-Person Tutoring Services

### Well-Being Programs

Orlando Health is proud to offer a multifaceted Well-Being Program to surround you with support. Whether you seek on-demand curated resources, a one-on-one coaching program to achieve financial stability, or professional counseling, we have you covered. Team members enrolled in an Orlando Health medical plan can earn up to $500 annually by participating.

### Orlando Health Is Your Best Place to Work

Orlando Health is committed to providing you with benefits that go beyond the expected, career-growing education programs and services to support you and your family through every stage of life. We begin your benefits on day one and offer flexibility wherever possible so that you can be present for your passions. “Orlando Health Is Your Best Place to Work” is not just something we say, **it’s our promise to you.**

### Benefits

Medical and Prescription Drug Plan

Dental and Vision Plans

Paid Time Off (PTO)

Retirement Savings Plan

FSAs and HSAs

Disability and Life Insurance

#### Medical and Prescription Drug Plan

We offer several medical plans from which to choose, allowing for flexibility that fits your life. Enjoy discounted Orlando Health medical services and on-site pharmacy access. Additionally, team members have the opportunity to earn monetary incentives by participating in the LifeWorks Well-Being Program.

#### Dental and Vision Plans

We offer a choice of three different dental plans and a comprehensive vision plan.

#### Paid Time Off (PTO)

We know the flexibility to take time off work is important to your well-being. That’s why Orlando Health offers a comprehensive PTO policy that gives you time off for vacation, holidays, personal business or personal and family illness. New, full-time team members can earn nearly five weeks of PTO each year! We also offer a voluntary PTO cash-in option (at 75% value) four times a year.

#### Retirement Savings Plan

No matter how much you love your career, you likely still dream about retirement. Orlando Health cares about your future financial security and offers up to a 5% matching contribution.

#### FSAs and HSAs

Our flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts offer a variety of options to help you save money on healthcare spending.

#### Disability and Life Insurance

Orlando Health provides group term life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability at no cost to our team members. Life insurance options for self, spouse and children are available.

![Education Programs](https://cms.jibecdn.com/prod/orlandohealth-oh-benefits/assets/LP-SKU-D4-IMG-en-us-1667503191010.png)

### Education Programs

Finances shouldn’t be a roadblock to your career. We offer a Preferred Education Program that allows you to pursue an associate degree, bachelor’s degree or technical certificate at select institutions with **no out-of-pocket costs!** Other educational assistance programs include tuition reimbursement (up to $5,000 a year) and student loan repayment ($1,200 per year) for eligible team members and free programs to help you obtain your high school diploma or pursue English as a second language.

### Career Development and Advancement

We have an entire department dedicated to your career advancement. While we strive to be your very last employer, we commit ourselves to helping you answer the question, “What’s next?”   
  
 We offer career consulting, workshops and events, talent development and leadership curriculums, and much more!

![Career Development and Advancement](https://cms.jibecdn.com/prod/orlandohealth-oh-benefits/assets/LP-SKU-D4-1-IMG-en-us-1667501962087.png)

![Family Care Benefits](https://cms.jibecdn.com/prod/orlandohealth-oh-benefits/assets/LP-SKU-D4-2-IMG-en-us-1667503277884.png)

### Family Care Benefits

Life happens. So, we created benefits for that. Orlando Health is committed to supporting you as you care for your family. Whether something unexpected happens or you’re returning to work after the birth or adoption of a child, we’re here for you.   
  
Team members can enjoy:

- Four weeks paid parental leave for benefits-eligible team members
- Fertility Benefits, *up to $25K lifetime maximum*
- Adoption Assistance, *up to $15K per child toward eligible expenses*
- Back-up Child Care, Elder Care and Pet Care
- Virtual and In-Person Tutoring Services

### Well-Being Programs

Orlando Health is proud to offer a multifaceted Well-Being Program to surround you with support. Whether you seek on-demand curated resources, a one-on-one coaching program to achieve financial stability, or professional counseling, we have you covered. Team members enrolled in an Orlando Health medical plan can earn up to $500 annually by participating.

You can view your bill online, visit our Patient Portal, or call us for verification.

Insurance information can be updated by phone, email, fax or mail.

Payment plans can be set up by phone, email, or mail by selecting the payment option on the bill.

To add new balances to an existing payment plan please contact us to set up a new payment plan.

## Grievance Process

The Orlando Health Grievance Process provides the opportunity to dispute charges that appear on a patient’s itemized statement or bill. (FL Statue 395.301) [...] Once an account is determined to be the patient’s responsibility, Orlando Health will make a combination of phone and mail attempts over a 60-90 day period to reach the patient in order to obtain payment in full or to establish an agreed upon payment plan. If neither are done at the end of this time, the hospital has no choice but to seek assistance form one of our bad debt recovery companies.

## **Grievance Process**

The Orlando Health Grievance Process provides the opportunity to dispute charges that appear on a patient’s itemized statement or bill. (FL Statue 395.301)

Point of information: Hospitals are not paid separately for each item or supply listed on your bill. Instead, they often receive a set payment for your treatment, regardless of the number of items or services rendered This means that even though your bill might list each item separately, the hospital's payment doesn't increase with every item shown on the itemized listing.

Initial concerns related to charges should be shared with billing customer service at 321-841-2596 as they are often able to answer common questions and concerns.

If you wish to take your dispute further, please submit the following information in writing:

Name of person submitting request and relationship to patient

Patient First Name, Patient Last Name

Patient Date of Birth

Phone number

Email address: if electronic communication can be used for response from Orlando Health

Account Number

Has billing customer service been contacted? Yes or No

Date of visit or admission

Description of grievance: Please provide a description of your billing item in dispute and any supporting reasoning for the dispute.

Any item from section D that is missing may cause delayed response to submitted request.

Please mail written correspondence to:   
Orlando Health Billing Customer Service Written Grievance Process  
1414 Kuhl Ave, MP 65  
Orlando, FL 32806

Please allow 7 days from receipt of request for response.
